name: ghostmind-toolkits
description: Ghostmind's misc skills, commands, and hooks as one Claude Code plugin, and our mods as plugins of their own.

plugins.name: toolkits
plugins.description: Ghostmind's misc skills, commands, and hooks for Claude Code.

plugins.name: session-name
plugins.description: Always shows this session's name above the prompt: the name other Claude sessions message it by.

plugins.name: session-badge
plugins.description: A colourful always-on badge above the prompt: this session's name, whether it is working, turns, tool calls, messages from other sessions, uptime and a sparkline of recent turns.

plugins.name: session-beacon
plugins.description: A band above the prompt showing this session's peer name and whether it is receiving from or sending to another session.

plugins.name: session-inbox
plugins.description: A pane that shows this session's name (the address other sessions message it at) and the messages that arrive from other sessions.
